# Grill me (Matt Pocock)

Has Claude interview you relentlessly to stress-test a plan or design.

- Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattpocock/skills/main/skills/productivity/grill-me/SKILL.md
- Author: Matt Pocock
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/grill-me-matt-pocock-5a2bccb3

A very short skill that turns Claude into a demanding interviewer: it questions your plan or design one point at a time until the gaps and assumptions are exposed. It is set to manual use only, so you run it as /grill-me rather than it triggering on its own. Popular as a quick way to sharpen an idea before building.

**Try asking:**
- "/grill-me on my plan to rewrite the API in Go"
- "/grill-me about this pricing change"
- "/grill-me before I start the migration"
